support.statement: usable == True is impossible at this level for the fixed n: the Wilson upper bound of the proven blocking rows alone exceeds the threshold even if every other row were False

strong.statement: usable == True is impossible at this level for the fixed n: the Wilson upper bound of the proven blocking rows alone exceeds the threshold even if every other row were False

aggregation.rule: per (row, family, level) the proofs must agree (a screen's unknown_or_technical may be refined by an evaluated unknown / technical_fail; an evaluated False contradicts any non-False proof of the same (row, family, level)); per row the families are combined as in calibration.any_family_truth (technical_fail > True > unknown > False); a row counts once
aggregation.blocking: any family True / unknown / unknown_or_technical -> the row adds 1 to c + u whatever the other families' non-technical outcomes
aggregation.technical: any family technical_fail -> the calibration is technical (no usable value); counted apart, never as c + u
aggregation.unknown_or_technical: a screen row: unknown unless a technical failure occurs in its evaluation (then usable itself fails); a True in another family does not remove that possibility
aggregation.false_rows: evaluated False statuses are RETAINED as admitted evidence (R-D4C2A-D1) and reconciled per (row, family, level); a row False in every admitted family at a level is never counted as blocking at that level

scope: fixed-denominator ALGEBRAIC infeasibility statement: proven blocking rows vs the first blocking count of wilson_upper(k, n) > threshold; carries no c / u / rate, no statement about unevaluated rows, no technical-success claim for them, no usable == False calibration; not a partial, not a sealed calibration (rejected by their readers); E1 rows enter only as evaluated statuses
